category_title: Low-achieving EFL learners exhibiting hesitation, distraction, and lack of participation in mainstream classes
scenario_title: Catching up on missed grammar units in remedial session
minimal_context: The student and tutor are working one-on-one on a worksheet covering count and non-count nouns and the rules for 'some' and 'any'.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to look at the worksheet for count and non-count nouns, and learn the rules for 'some' and 'any'.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Ok teacher I want to do units from one to four.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just start with the first rule on this page.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just read the sentence on the worksheet again.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Speaks in Arabic) I didn't attend the classes for some reason, so I want to just catch up with my class. I want like a pill, a condensed, quick course to revise.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Today we are going to look at the worksheet for count and non-count nouns, and learn the rules for 'some' and 'any'.

STUDENT: Ok teacher I want to do units from one to four.

TUTOR: Let's just start with the first rule on this page.

STUDENT: Why this? Can you repeat?

TUTOR: Just read the sentence on the worksheet again.

STUDENT: (Speaks in Arabic) I didn't attend the classes for some reason, so I want to just catch up with my class. I want like a pill, a condensed, quick course to revise.
